title: ID0377117-DC/Si-D/DK-Firmware update
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
cannot update the charger to firmware
v4.0.11-0-g0b7d164+SF-RETOPICS
Root cause:
Rollout is stuck
Solution:
Manual update via SSH
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active
NOTE TO L3 in TIMELINE:
Charger updated to V4.0.11 but is missing network security patch
During the first try to install on the reboot, the state monitor from dispenser got damaged, needs to be replaced.
------------------------------------//-------------------------------------
Reported behaviour/issue:
DC3 and DC4 not performing fastshutdown
Root cause:
StateMonitor KF214 constantly 12V.
Solution:
Replace KF214
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active
